memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Obesity
  - Status: Weight 92 kg, waist circumference 96 cm (>90 cm cut-off for men).
  - Plan: Continue orlistat 120 mg TID with meals. Diet: breakfast – high‑fibre cereal, low‑fat milk; lunch – mixed vegetable curry with lean protein, limited rice; dinner – grilled fish, steamed vegetables, small portion of roti. Review weight and waist in 3 months.
- Glaucoma
  - Status: On timolol BD and latanoprost HS; no visual symptoms reported.
  - Plan: Continue current drops. Schedule intraocular pressure check and visual field test in 4 months.
- Hypertension
  - Status: BP today 148/92 mmHg.
  - Plan: Continue amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, losartan 50 mg OD, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD. Aim for BP <130/80 mmHg.
Due: HbA1c re‑check in 3 months (2025‑07‑05).
